what: On a pinned screen, several colored panels stand aside at the right edge with only a tab strip showing (later panels have tabs further in), and every two screens of scroll one slides in from the right to cover the previous panel. The covered panel darkens down to .6, and the entering panel’s vertical progress bar fills until the next panel arrives

options.per: Scroll for one panel to enter (screen multiple), default 1.5
options.gap: Scroll held between panels (screen multiples), default .5
options.tail: Scroll left after the last panel (screen multiples), default 1 — Section height = Number of panels × (per + gap) + tail
options.lead: Start position of the first panel (where the section top edge sits on screen, in %), default 40%
options.--fx-tab: Tab width one panel leaves visible (CSS length), default 6rem — on phones the caller shrinks it, e.g. 1.5rem
options.[data-fx-part=stage]: Panel stuck to the screen (position: sticky). Required
options.[data-fx-part=panel]: Color panels — front-to-back order. Must be present
options.[data-fx-part=bar]: Vertical progress bar inside the panel (if present) — fills top to bottom with --fx-bar (0→1)

use:
To stay
To eat
Play
note: When a panel turns on (its turn begins) is-on is added — background photo and text reveal are hooked to is-on by the consuming CSS. The dimming is read from the panel’s --fx-dim by the ::after veil
